title: General
description: Appearance, language and the explorer, in this browser and on your account.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose how Transferly looks. The theme is saved to your account and follows you to other browsers.
appearance.followSystemHint: Use a light theme by day and a dark one by night, as your operating system does.
appearance.saveFailed: The theme is applied here, but it could not be saved to your account.

language.title: Language
language.label: Interface language
language.saveFailed: The language applies here, but it could not be saved to your account.

servers.title: Trusted servers
servers.description: Servers whose key you accepted. Transferly warns you if a server ever presents a different key.
servers.empty: No server has been trusted yet.
servers.forgetBody: {{host}} will stop being trusted with the key {{fingerprint}}. If it presents that key again, you will be asked to confirm it.

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to change this workspace.
errors.host_key_not_found: This server key is already gone.

servers.loadFailed: The trusted servers could not be loaded.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The address does not lead anywhere in Transferly.

explorer.title: File explorer
explorer.doubleClickHint: Enter does the same, and Space always shows the file in the viewer. The other actions stay in the right-click menu and in the details panel.
explorer.saveFailed: The choice applies here, but it could not be saved to your account.

securityPage.title: Security
securityPage.description: How you sign in and what protects your account.
